note: Offline, deterministic, mock-provider probes of every Task 1 candidate. Counts, hashes and verdicts only; no note or history text.
rule: fires: the mechanism ran (count); reaches: what the agent receives differs with it on vs off (or vs its trigger-absent control); correct: the documented effect. A replay rate under 1% of eligible units is rare.

fixes.summary: The package built its own tool set without the cross-scope routing createMemoryFabric().tools() has: memory.read { around | session } always returned not_found, memory.replace { id, pin } ignored pin, and a replace or verify of a note outside the narrowest scope missed it.
fixes.change: Shared createNoteNavigator (navigation.ts) used by both tool sets; the package passes navigateNotes, noteMemory and routed pin/verify.

fixes.summary: recall.expansion scaled the store's floor but reported coverage over the expanded terms, so a match found only through an alternate (one caller term) fell under memory.recall's 0.34 no-match confidence and the tool abstained.
fixes.change: Hit coverage is reported over the caller's own terms, the same scale as the floor (opt-in variant; default off, unchanged).

fixes.summary: rules.capture: "confirm" runs inside the exchange archive's task, so without `exchanges` it silently captured nothing. Both presets turn the archive on.
fixes.change: Setup leaves a warning status note and the README states the dependency; making capture independent of the archive is a design change for Task 3.

fixes.summary: The inspectability role had no named test.
fixes.change: Named test added; the row becomes safety-proven.

fixes.summary: The inspectability role had no named test.
fixes.change: Named test added; the row becomes safety-proven.

fixes.summary: The package's per-turn lifecycle task (uses, co-reads, retrievals, helpful/harmful evidence) runs on a project-only lifecycle, so a cited user- or agent-scope note never gains a use, never verifies by use and never builds R or S. Routing it needs each scope's own clock for the use event, a contract question.

probes.property: decisions binds a decisions model; points share batched calls; an answer inside the abstain band keeps the incumbent
P1 clearly not durable skips rule capture (and the generative extractor) for that turn
probes.finding: The extractor leg of P1 runs only with promote on and fresh observational-memory material; this probe drives the capture leg, which shares the same per-turn call.

probes.property: P2 classifies the new note's relation to each consolidation candidate; a confident replaces supersedes the old note
P3 drops passive candidates clearly below the relevance band
P4 clearly not needed skips passive injection for the turn
P5 clearly not sufficient turns a recall with hits into an abstention
P6 drops a path cue the model places clearly below the applies band
P7 clearly instruction-like refuses rule capture (it only adds refusals)
a weak-only result (best coverage below 0.34) becomes an abstention line naming the terms and scopes; a strong one returns hits
the memory directory block lists note counts and topics (tags) in the context prefix
with inject on, the turn's matching notes are delivered as an untrusted semantic tail after the transcript; the unrelated note is not
after a file tool touches a path, a standing decision whose glob matches is cued in the tail
the default minSimilarity/minScore floors (0.2) drop a weak single-term match from passive delivery and keep the strong one
with capture confirm, an imperative user turn is proposed as a rule and, once confirmed, written and shown in the rules block
a person's edit of rules.md is reconciled into notes at the next session start, so that session's rules block shows the edited text
a verified preference in a rule scope is pinned in the standing-rules block of the context prefix
passive delivery starts as pointers and switches to excerpts after two cued turns without a memory.* call; a memory call resets it
probes.finding: Needs two cued turns in one session; a one-question benchmark session never reaches the switch (oneTurnSessionSwitched 0).

replay.note: a session reaches excerpts after two cued turns without a memory.* call

probes.property: a working block written by memory.insert is rendered as the working-memory tail block on later turns

replay.note: no replayed turn writes a working block (scripted replies make no tool call)

probes.property: the memory toggle hides every fabric tool for the session; memory:status counts notes by lifecycle status
probes.finding: Inspectability now rests on the named test memory_toggle_and_status_commands_are_inspectable (package.test.ts).

probes.property: a concept note renders as [id] level concept subject with its current claims and the ids they cite
a decision is written proposed (a candidate) and becomes active once used in two sessions
kind episode is a view of an observational-memory observation: the note carries its content and writes no row; without an OM source it is refused
probes.finding: The package never passes an observational source to its fabric and no tool writes kind episode, so the view is reachable only from a library host; episode rows in the store come only from the consolidation extractor (promote on), which both presets leave off.

probes.property: a fact note is stored at its scope and returned by the default recall kinds
the startup reconcile indexes a file under tools.root as a file note that recall returns with its path
a preference without an explicit scope lands in the user scope; a fact lands in the project
a procedure is kept out of default library recall and passive injection; naming the kind returns it
with lessons.nudge and the exchange archive, a remember/correction/fix turn adds one nudge to cite the exchange in a lesson

replay.note: lessons.nudge is off in both presets

probes.property: a note below both strength thresholds past the grace window is archived (hidden from active recall), and a citation revives it

replay.note: one memory:maintain pass after the replay; on the conversational preset the archived notes are raw exchanges

probes.property: over budget, the lowest S·exp(R) notes are evicted to the archive until the scope fits; a pinned note is never evicted
over budget, near-duplicates (Dice ≥ duplicateDice) fold into one survivor before any eviction, so a distinct note survives
over budget, an episode cluster of one subject is summarised by one model call into one candidate note and its episodes are archived

replay.note: no product path writes episode rows with promote off

probes.property: exchanges over hotTokens are demoted to the searchable archive (never deleted), oldest/weakest first
memory:maintain runs one pass and reports its counts; memory:lifecycle reports the lifecycle state
a candidate cited in verifyAfterSessions distinct sessions becomes verified and ranks before candidates; a retrieval alone or a repeat in one session is not a use
probes.finding: Fires only on candidate notes the model cites as [id]. The conversational and coding presets turn promotion off, so their notes are written by tools or the exchange archive, not as candidates; under either preset verification has no eligible note (see the replay rates).

replay.note: only candidate notes cited as [id] in two sessions; scripted replies cite nothing

probes.property: a lesson verified with the same normalized text in minProjects projects widens to the agent scope, readable from a third project
memory.read around returns the exchange with its same-session ±2 neighbours; session pages a session in reference-time order
om toggles the session, om:status reports counts and pass state, om:view renders the ledger
probes.finding: Inspectability now rests on the named test om_commands_expose_session_state_for_inspection (observational.test.ts).

probes.property: OM owns the compaction slot: a compaction is built from the ledger and the next request carries the observational-memory block
lowest-relevance drops the lowest-relevance observations first with no model call
over dropper.targetTokens the model dropper makes one call and the observations it names leave the active pool
past messageTokens the observer makes one call on its own model and records observations sourced from the new entries
under a foreign compactor, OM pins its ledger block after the compaction and keeps it byte-identical; it never forces the foreign owner
the OM recall tool reads this session's observation by exact id (and pages raw messages by cursor)
past reflector.observationTokens the reflector condenses observations into a reflection that the rendered block shows
the observer's record_task_state replaces the current task section the rendered block shows
a new note containing bindThreshold tokens of a subject's name binds to that subject
probes.finding: At the default bindThreshold 2 a note naming one token of a two-token subject title does not bind; threshold 1 binds it.

probes.property: a subject the extractor names on a recorded note binds that note (the tier then curates it)
the tier composes with the coding preset: a pass under preset coding still yields a recallable concept
the concept prior lifts a matching concept above its own evidence notes
memory:share copies a concept into the team store, where its claims stand on the share
a due subject gets one edit_concept call; a valid cited edit lands as a claim; a quiet scope makes no call
when a concept is in play for the turn, the passive tail adds one pointer line naming it instead of its text
wiki_ingest stages a workspace file under the memory root and indexes its extract as a file note recall returns
with memory-wiki over the fabric, a curator pass turns a note cluster into a concept that recall renders with cited claims; without the wiki no concept is ever written
minNotes uncited bound notes make their subject due
two bound notes cited together in minCoReads turns make their subject due before the accumulation threshold
forgetting a cited note leaves its concept due for repair even with every other trigger off
the coding preset turns on the exchange archive, confirmed rule capture and the coding rules block, and memory:status names it
with expansion, a formal query term matches its informal table alternate (mother → mom)
gather returns the whole matching history in one call, oldest first, past the 5-hit default page
the kinds argument restricts recall to the named kinds; the tool default searches every kind except working
queries fuses up to 4 phrasings by rank and deduplicates by id
same-key hits form one group ordered newest first, and the older member carries a supersededBy hint (nothing removed)
state adds one model call per explicit recall and prepends a model-generated current-state table to the tool result
the default (all) marks an older same-subject exchange as superseded by the newer one; keyed-only marks only keyed notes
terms no returned note contains are listed in unmatchedTerms and named in a rephrase line; matched terms are not
a higher per-kind decay lowers R after idle sessions, so the slower-decaying kind's equal note ranks first
hybrid adds the embeddings leg (hits tagged hybrid/vector) and still admits the exact lexical identifier
probes.finding: Compatibility only: no preset uses it and lexical is the default; the leg needs an embeddings service the package resolves per agent.

probes.property: lexical recall returns the note holding the exact identifier first; without indexed notes recall is unavailable
the default scope priors (project 0.10 > agent 0.05) order an otherwise-equal project note first
a seed hit's similar link brings the linked note into the result, marked link: true
the default w_R·σ(R) + w_S·σ(S) (0.05 each) orders a used note before an equal unused one
probes.finding: Documented exception: with one active scope recall skips fusion and every prior, so a library fabric bound to one scope never applies R or S. The package's default scopes (project, agent, user) always fuse.

probes.property: an agent-scope note is shared across projects for the same agent
a path note earns the path prior (0.15 over project 0.10) only when a touched path matches its glob; otherwise it ranks as a project note
a project note is recalled in its own project and never in another project sharing the store
a narrower note with the same key hides the wider one (explain names it shadowedBy); different keys both return
memory:share copies a note into the checked-in team store after a confirmation; recall reads team notes as a read-only level
a user-scope note written in one project is recalled in another; a project note is not
the scoped policy's activation floor admits a matching scoped note at the default 0.35 and refuses it at 1
a SQLite-backed note written by one agent is recalled by a new agent on the same store; the in-memory store loses it
probes.finding: Postgres is not probed offline (no database in the free run); its integration suites stay the evidence.

probes.property: the archive resolves a relative date at write time; from/to keeps only notes dated in the window; order time sorts oldest first
memory.insert writes a typed note with agent provenance that recall returns; memory.replace edits that note in place
evolution unions the new note's keywords into its neighbours (annotations only), so a neighbour matches the new keyword
on write the linker stores similar links to the nearest notes, which recall's link expansion then follows
default consolidation folds a same-text write into the existing note; a near-duplicate (Dice ≥ 0.85) is kept as a new note with a similar link
with decider model, a near-duplicate write asks the model once (ADD/UPDATE/SUPERSEDE/NOOP) and applies its answer
with exchanges.steps, the turn's tool steps (name, declared argument fields, outcome) are archived with the exchange

replay.note: exchanges.steps is off in both presets

probes.property: the archive enriches each exchange with entity and category keywords, so a paraphrase (travel) finds a flight turn
observational-memory reflections are consolidation sources: fresh OM material triggers the pass and the reflection reaches the extractor
with promote on, a consolidation pass gathers the session's sources, makes one extractor call and writes candidate notes
